name: line_chart_overlay_up
desc: This template overlays a clean, animated line chart directly onto a background video or image. A title and the final numerical value are displayed prominently. The line graph animates in, typically with a "draw-on" effect from left to right, visualizing the increase trend of the data over time. The background is often thematically related to the data being presented.

placeholders.desc: Title of the line chart, usually a description of the data.
A final numerical value (e.g., dollar amount, score, metric) with an optional unit (e.g., $, %, etc.).
an image or video in 9:16 format

useCases:
- Financial & Business Reporting: The primary use. Display key performance metrics like "Quarterly Sales," "Stock Price," or "User Growth" over time.
- Scientific Data Visualization: In educational videos or documentaries, use this to show trends like "Global Temperatures," "Species Population," or "CO2 Levels."
- Analytics & Performance Tracking: Show the growth of a YouTube channel, social media account, or website traffic over a specific period.
- Fitness & Personal Progress: Visualize progress in a fitness journey by charting metrics like "Weight," "Running Distance," or "Lifting Max" over weeks or months.
